question: For the NXT title that had the shortest match (excluding titles with "title change"), what were the names of the two wrestlers involved?
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    b.name AS belt_name,
    m.duration,
    w_winner.name AS winner_name,
    w_loser.name AS loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts b ON CAST(m.title_id AS INTEGER) = b.id
JOIN Wrestlers w_winner ON CAST(m.winner_id AS INTEGER) = w_winner.id
JOIN Wrestlers w_loser ON CAST(m.loser_id AS INTEGER) = w_loser.id
WHERE b.name LIKE '%NXT%'
  AND m.title_change = 0
  AND m.duration != ''
ORDER BY m.duration ASC
LIMIT 1
